pages.text: $(item)Mailbox$()es send parcels between players. Right-click one, type who it's for, put things in and pay the postage: the parcel waits in the mailbox and its flag goes up.$(br2)The $(item)Mail Van$() carries the mail: drive up beside a mailbox and press $(k:key.reikocars.hitch) to collect and deliver. The driver earns each parcel's postage.
